technology_name: A ZERO-BIAS RETINOMORPHIC PHOTODETECTOR ON A PAPER-BASED SUBSTRATE AND METHOD OF FABRICATING THE SAME
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Neuromorphic machine vision systems struggle with heavy power draw and hardware bulk because traditional image sensors require an external power supply to process light transitions.
description: A biomimetic, zero-bias retinomorphic photodetector fabricated directly on a cellulose paper substrate using a niobium disulfide ($NbS_2$) channel, copper electrodes, and discrete silver spots to naturally replicate human retinal light-adaptation responses.
applications: Neuromorphic AI vision processors, edge-computing machine vision systems, low-power industrial sortation cameras, and sustainable disposable optical diagnostic strips.
